def: a Ninevite, i.e. inhabitant of Nineveh

occurrences.text: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
